adoration.text: Adoration room open 06:00–22:15 daily, closed every Wednesday 10:00–12:00 for cleaning.

confession.text: Confession is 30 minutes before weekend Masses in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Liturgy of the Word for Children every 2nd and 4th Sunday at the 10:30am Mass.
Holy Hour and Devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus on Friday 6 Nov after the 6pm evening Mass.

good_to_know.text: All weekend Masses on 31 Oct/1 Nov 2026 celebrate All Saints.

events.title: Breathe Retreat
events.text: For youths and young adults aged 16-30. The Breathe retreat team from the Catholic Spirituality Centre is at OLPS this weekend of 24/25 Oct to share more about encountering Jesus anew as you rest in Him and learn to walk in His ways. Drop by the booth to learn more.

events.title: Certificate in Bioethics information session
events.text: Online via Zoom. Conducted by the Catholic Medical Guild of Singapore and The Catholic Theological Institute of Singapore. Register at https://www.cmg.org.sg/cmg-ctis-certificate-in-bioethics/ to receive the Zoom link.

events.title: Milestone Wedding Celebration @ OLPS
events.text: Couples celebrating their milestone wedding anniversaries (5th, 10th, 15th and multiple of 5 years thereafter) are invited to attend the 6:30pm Mass followed by a dinner celebration. Registration closes on 30 Oct 2026. Contact Patrick @ 91797723 or visit olps.sg/milestone2026.

events.title: Youth in the Spirit Seminar
events.text: Held on 17-20 Dec 2026. A $15 discount is available for the first 15 parishioners to sign up. Drop by the booth to learn more.
